evidence.note: 文本生成 tab click left the video tab active on an image node

observations.text: Navigating to /infinite-canvas with no id immediately creates a persisted canvas: URL rewrites to ?canvasId=2097273517239623682 and a card '未命名故事 2026/09/08 18:39' appears in /my-space?tab=canvas. No 'create' dialog, no naming step.

The header names the container 未命名故事 and offers 画布 / 编辑器 tabs, but the canvas is listed ONLY under my-space 画布, not under 故事. So a canvas is its own top-level object that reuses the story shell (title + editor tab).
Node selection is written to the URL (&nodeId=…), i.e. selection is deep-linkable.

A blank node carries the generator panel for all four media types; submitting converts the blank node IN PLACE into a typed node (label 空白节点 → 图片) with a new server id (uuid → snowflake), same position. The prompt and config stay attached to the node and are shown again when it is re-selected.

Generation submit is silent: no confirm dialog; credit balance decremented immediately (110→109 for Seko Image 1K ✦1; 109→108 for 多角度 ✦1). Cost is shown as a ✦N chip next to the send button and changes live with model/resolution (即梦 5.0 Pro 2K ✦7 → 1K ✦4 → Seko Image 1K ✦1).

Job lifecycle inside the node: 排队中，请稍候 (+ 会员加速 upsell link) → 生成中，请稍候 → image rendered in node. ~60 s for a 1K image. No separate job center was found on this surface; the '生成历史' concept (rail tooltip) says all canvas generations are kept even if nodes are deleted.

Derivative operations (多角度) create a NEW node to the right of the source, connected by an edge (3 SVG paths in .react-flow__edges), and the result is a distinct asset URL. The source node is unchanged. This is the provenance model: source → derived node via edge.
Persistence: after navigating away and re-opening the canvasId URL, both nodes, their images and the edge are restored; the in-flight 多角度 job completed while the page was away.
Selecting a node auto-attaches it to the Agent composer as a '图片' chip (上传 / 选择 / 图片 thumbnail), i.e. canvas selection is agent context.

Reusable identity: '@ 引用角色' in the prompt and the 主体库 rail modal both list ~62 public subjects (公共) and a 个人 tab; 添加新主体 supports category 角色/场景, a voice (音色) and an image (local or AI-generated). Subjects also have a top-level route /characters, so scope is account-level, not per-canvas.

Model catalogue on canvas: 20 image models (即梦 5.0 Pro/Lite/4.5/4.0/3.0, 全能图片 G2/NB Pro/NB 2/NB, Qwen Image 3.0 Pro/3.0, 极致美学 V8.2/V8.1/V7/Niji7, Wan 2.7 Pro/2.7, Z-Image, Seko Image, Seko IDX) and 31 video models (Seedance 2.5/2.5普惠/2.0/2.0普惠/Fast/Mini/1.5 Pro/1.0 Pro/1.0 Pro Fast, MiniMax H3, Wan 3.0 Prime/3.0/2.7/2.6/2.5/2.2 Plus/2.2 Flash, HappyHorse 1.1/1.0, 可灵 3.0/2.6/2.5 Turbo/2.1/2.1 大师版, Pixverse V5.6/V5, Vidu Q2, 海螺 2.3/2.0, Seko 1.5); audio default Mureka V9 ✦3; agent LLM picker lists 9 models + 智能选择.
Escape does not close Radix popovers on this surface; they close on outside click. Rail modals stack (opening a second while one is open leaves both mounted).
The 编辑器 tab is a timeline/编辑 surface fed by 合成视频 → 添加到编辑器; it is inert until a video/composition exists (clicking it changed nothing on an image-only canvas).

The generator panel keeps the previous prompt when switching 图片生成 → 视频生成 (首帧/尾帧 slots appear, image becomes first frame), so an image node is the natural parent of a video node (image-to-video chain).
Whether 九宫格/全景/打光/对口型/消除笔 spend credits immediately or open a config panel first — not triggered (budget).
